## 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🎯 Problem This Solves
Why is this feature needed? What problem does it address?

How does this feature connect to understanding authentic personality through behavior?

## 🌍 Privacy Consideration
Does this feature maintain our 100% local, offline-first principle?
- [ ] Yes, stays completely local
- [ ] Requires discussion
- [ ] Needs major privacy review

## 🤔 Alternative Approaches
Have you considered other ways to solve this?

## 📚 Related Research
Any behavioral psychology research or papers related to this feature?
